description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- fix(logging): keep routine server diagnostics behind debug mode by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4837
- fix(reflection): disable automatic client-side dreaming on Windows by default by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4838
- feat(subagents): capture native coding-agent sessions [LET-13370] by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4820
- feat(cli): add letta sandbox desktop-link to share a live Cloud desktop by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4841
- feat(workflow): support local backend workers by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4840
- chore: bump version to 0.33.6 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4843
Full Changelog: https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/compare/v0.33.5...v0.33.6
